name: Все санкции по убыванию даты
source:
SELECT date_start, event
FROM tagged_events
WHERE tag = 'SANCTIONS'
ORDER BY date_start DESC
LIMIT 30

name: Див. объявл. LKOH с CAR
source:
SELECT te.date_start,
       te.event,
       car('LKOH', te.date_start) AS car
FROM tagged_events te
JOIN tagged_events te2 ON te2.event_id = te.event_id
WHERE te.tag = 'LKOH'
  AND te2.tag = 'DIVIDEND_ANNOUNCEMENT'
ORDER BY te.date_start DESC
LIMIT 20;

name: Сравнение 3 est. models LKOH
source:
SELECT te.date_start,
       car('LKOH', te.date_start, model => 'mean_adjusted') AS car_mean,
       car('LKOH', te.date_start, model => 'market_model')  AS car_market,
       car('LKOH', te.date_start, model => 'capm')          AS car_capm
FROM tagged_events te
WHERE te.tag = 'SANCTIONS'
  AND te.date_start > DATE '2018-01-01'
ORDER BY te.date_start DESC;

name: Топ-10 компаний по количеству дивидендных выплат
source:
SELECT te.tag AS ticker,
       COUNT(*) AS payments
FROM tagged_events te
JOIN tagged_events te2 ON te2.event_id = te.event_id
WHERE te2.tag = 'DIVIDEND_PAYMENT'
  AND te.tag IN (SELECT code FROM tags WHERE type = 'company')
GROUP BY te.tag
ORDER BY payments DESC
LIMIT 10;

name: Дивиденды GAZP с indow_after=30 и CAR > 0.05
source:
SELECT te.date_start,
       car('GAZP', te.date_start, window_before => 5, window_after => 30) AS car_30
FROM tagged_events te
JOIN tagged_events te2 ON te2.event_id = te.event_id
WHERE te.tag = 'GAZP'
  AND te2.tag = 'DIVIDEND_ANNOUNCEMENT'
  AND ABS(car('GAZP', te.date_start, window_before => 5, window_after => 30)) > 0.05
ORDER BY ABS(car_30) DESC
LIMIT 15;

name: Топ-10 изменений после объявления див.
source:
WITH announcements AS (
  SELECT te1.event_id, te1.tag AS ticker, te1.date_start
  FROM tagged_events te1
  JOIN tagged_events te2 ON te2.event_id = te1.event_id
  WHERE te2.tag = 'DIVIDEND_ANNOUNCEMENT'
    AND te1.tag IN (SELECT code FROM tags WHERE type = 'company')
)
SELECT ticker, date_start, car(ticker, date_start) AS car
FROM announcements
WHERE car(ticker, date_start) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY abs(car) DESC
LIMIT 10
